{{Quote|You'll report to Orlo, the bordok master.''"<br />"''That's me. Congratulations, Wicket. We'll start training tomorrow.|Chirpa introduces Wicket Wystri Warrick to Orlo|audio=Orlo-Ewoks.flac|<ref name="Just My Luck" />}}
'''Orlo''' was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived in [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]]. He worked as a [[Bordok/Legends|bordok]] [[Beastmaster/Legends|master]] and was responsible for sweeping the [[City/Legends|village's]] bordok stables. Around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Orlo was appointed an [[Aide/Legends|assistant]], the young Ewok [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]], who had failed his [[skills test]] for becoming a [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]]. However, Warrick left the position shortly after to pursue his dreams of being a warrior again.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Here, Orlo will have an opening for a new bordok sweeper.|Wicket Wystri Warrick gives the lucksprite his cloak and broom|audio=BordokSweeper-Ewoks.flac|<ref name="Just My Luck" />}}
[[File:WicketmeetsOrlo-JML.png|thumb|left|235px|Chirpa brings Wicket Wystri Warrick to Orlo.]]
Orlo was an [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who resided on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]],<ref name="Just My Luck" /> a [[Forest/Legends|forested]] [[Moon/Legends|moon]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Geonosis">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> He was a member of the [[Bright Tree Village tribe|tribe]] that inhabited [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]], serving as the [[City/Legends|village's]] [[Bordok/Legends|bordok]] [[Beastmaster/Legends|master]].<ref name="Just My Luck" /> By [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date note">{{EwoksDate|the events|[[Just My Luck]]}} Since Orlo appears in a flashback sequence of "Just My Luck," he must have met [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] by 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].</ref> when the young Ewok [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] failed his [[skills test]] for becoming a [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]], [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]] assigned Warrick to become Orlo's [[Aide/Legends|assistant]] stable sweeper. Chirpa brought Warrick to Orlo, who congratulated the younger Ewok and informed him that training would begin the following [[Standard day/Legends|day]].<ref name="Just My Luck" />

Warrick became disillusioned with his dream of becoming a warrior and resigned to his duties as Orlo's assistant. However, after being chided by his friend [[Latara/Legends|Latara]], Warrick left the village and retreated to the [[Cavern of Broken Dreams]]. When Latara, along with her friends [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] and [[Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka/Legends|Kneesaa a Jari Kintaka]], followed Warrick to the [[Cave/Legends|cavern]] and were attacked by a ferocious [[Unidentified Endor arachnid|creature]], Warrick defended them. With the creature defeated and his warrior dream renewed, Warrick gave his stable sweeping equipment to a disheartened [[Teebo's lucksprite|lucksprite]] and suggested that he apply to be Orlo's assistant. Sometime later, when the [[Wokling/Legends|wokling]] [[Malani]] was doubting her skills as a [[Artist/Legends|painter]], Warrick told her his story of becoming Orlo's assistant.<ref name="Just My Luck" />

==Personality and traits==
Orlo had [[Color/Legends|gray]] [[Hair/Legends|fur]] and dark-colored [[Eye/Legends|eyes]]. He was missing several [[Tooth/Legends|teeth]] and spoke with a lisp. When Orlo was introduced to Warrick, he spoke enthusiastically and congratulated the young Ewok.<ref name="Just My Luck" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|Well, perhaps you can retake the test someday, but for now I'm afraid your marks make you a bordok stable sweeper. Um, assistant bordok stable sweeper.|audio=AssistantSweeper-Ewoks.flac|Chirpa assigns Wicket Wystri Warrick to be Orlo's assistant|<ref name="Just My Luck" />}}
As the appointed bordok master of Bright Tree Village, Orlo was responsible for sweeping the village's stables.<ref name="Just My Luck" /> Bordoks, which were [[Horse/Legends|pony]]-like beasts of burden, often formed strong bonds with their owners.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|86|bordok}}</ref> The job was a low-qualifying position.<ref name="Just My Luck" />

==Equipment==
Orlo wore an orange, green-patched [[Cloak/Legends|cloak]] with a [[Clothing/Legends|hood]] and carried a [[Broom (tool)/Legends|broom]].<ref name="Just My Luck" />

==Behind the scenes==
Orlo appeared during a flashback sequence in "[[Just My Luck]],"<ref name="Just My Luck" /> the eighteenth episode in the [[Ewoks: Season Two|second season]] of the animated television series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']]. The episode was written by [[Michael Dubil]] and premiered on [[November 22]], [[1986]].<ref name="Insider 27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
